title: Reunification of Skyrim
description: Umbrella quest governing the Imperial Legion Civil War campaign. After defending Whiterun, report to General Tullius for promotion and orders, then conquer each Stormcloak-held hold by capturing its military fort through a series of sub-quests, culminating in the siege of Windhelm and the death of Ulfric Stormcloak.

base_facts: I command the Imperial Legion in Skyrim.
The Stormcloak rebellion must be crushed to reunify Skyrim under the Empire.
I promote soldiers who prove their loyalty and effectiveness in battle.

QUEST_STARTED: Whiterun is secured. I have a new soldier to help reclaim the remaining holds.
REPORT_TO_TULLIUS: I promoted the soldier to Quaestor and directed them to Legate Rikke for field assignment.
QUEST_COMPLETED: The rebellion is over. Ulfric Stormcloak is dead and Skyrim is once again part of the Empire.

base_facts: I am General Tullius's legate and field commander.
I give assignments at Imperial Military Camps across Skyrim.
Each Stormcloak-held hold must be taken by capturing its military fort.

QUEST_STARTED: Report to me at the assigned Imperial camp for your next orders.
HOLD_CONQUESTS: Another hold falls to the Empire. Report back for your next assignment.
QUEST_COMPLETED: The war is over. Skyrim is reunited under Imperial control.

beats.comment: Quest begins automatically after Battle for Whiterun. Player pledges to help reunify Skyrim under Imperial control.
Player reports to Tullius at Castle Dour after Whiterun defense, receives Quaestor rank and assignment to meet Rikke at an Imperial camp.
Ongoing phase: player conquers Stormcloak holds via sub-quests, reporting to Rikke at military camps between each operation.
After Fort Amol is taken, Rikke orders the final assault on Windhelm.
Ulfric Stormcloak is dead, the rebellion is crushed, and Skyrim is reunited under Imperial control.
